# ThesisAI

> AI-powered academic writing assistant that generates complete theses and research papers with automatic citations, LaTeX support, and multi-language accessibility.

ThesisAI is a comprehensive platform designed for students and researchers to create high-quality academic papers with AI assistance. The platform supports multiple languages and citation formats (APA, IEEE, Harvard, Chicago, Oxford) while offering document generation capabilities in various formats including LaTeX, PDF, and Word.

## Key Topics

- Thesis generation
- Academic writing assistant
- AI writing tool
- Citation management
- LaTeX support
- BibTeX
- APA citations
- IEEE citations
- Harvard citations
- Chicago citations
- Literature review
- Document generation
- Multilingual support
- PDF export
- Research assistant

## Getting Started

- [ThesisAI Homepage](https://www.thesisai.io): Main platform homepage featuring AI-powered academic paper generation with citations and LaTeX support for students and researchers.
- [Examples](https://www.thesisai.io/example): Sample academic papers generated by ThesisAI across various fields and formats demonstrating platform capabilities.
